items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Basie Band was there, we were there with Judy Garland

ctx.x: Oh, Margaret used to follow us all the time. She was quite a jazz fan. She -- you could always expect to see her when we were around. Of course, usually when we were there, for the amount of time, if a command performance was on, Basie Band was there, we were there with Judy Garland, this other guy, Italian singer, Enzo -- what was his name? (Singing) To be my love -- what's --
